public.title: Know who to call, who owes you, and what is left in the shop.
public.lead: Bizora is a simple place to keep customers, follow-ups, and the day-to-day of a Nigerian shop. It is light, fast, and it does not track you.
public.painCustomers: Customers live in your phone, not in a book you can search.
public.painDebt: You remember who owes you until the shop gets busy.
public.painMoney: Money in and money out get mixed together.

legal.draft: Draft — to be reviewed by counsel
privacy: This draft explains how Bizora handles personal information for shop owners and their customers. It is not legal advice and it has not been signed off by a lawyer.
Bizora is aimed at businesses in Nigeria. The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 applies to personal data we process about people in Nigeria, including names, phone numbers, and notes you type in.

We use that information to run your business account: sign-in, your shop setup, your customer list, and follow-ups. We do not sell personal data. This public site does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
Phone numbers are stored so you can call or open WhatsApp. A walk-in customer can be saved without a phone. You are responsible for telling your customers why you keep their details.
You can ask us to correct or delete your account data. Customer records you entered belong to your business and are removed when that business is deleted.
This page will be replaced after counsel reviews it. Until then, do not treat it as a finished privacy notice.
terms: These draft terms are a plain-language starting point for using Bizora. They must be reviewed by counsel before anyone relies on them.
Bizora helps a business record customers and follow-ups. Sales, stock, debt, and payments are not switched on yet. Do not use Bizora as your only record of money.
You must be allowed to keep the customer details you enter. The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 still applies to personal data of people in Nigeria.
Keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what your staff do inside your business.
The service is provided as it is today. We can suspend an account that is used to harm other people or to break the law.
This draft does not limit any right you have under Nigerian law that cannot be limited. A lawyer still needs to review this page.
